experiment: D3 (Codex ideas 5 and 6), development only, exploratory
status: candidate configuration; whether test runs is the user's and the rewrite session's decision

reflection.prompt: v6_d3_run.D3Prompts.symmetric(rec, scores=False): symmetric evidence cards for the previous ranking's top 3 and the first 3 candidates the action adds (NT: ranks 4 to 6), alphabetical, no origin marks; the dataset's correspondence rule (v6_d3_run.RULES) instead of the one-to-one conflicts line; the previous ranking with its order and reasons but no scores; then the current pairwise check (reflect_v2.Prompts.verify)

verifier.prompt: v6_d3_run.D3Prompts.blind with both option orders; accept the proposal when either order picks it
verifier.calls: two verifier calls per judged proposal (the current check makes one)

not_measured: symN reflection followed by the blind_either verifier together; a test run would need that combination checked on development first, or one of the two alone
caveat: Every D3 arm used reflect_v2.Prompts.desc, which truncates descriptions to 300 characters; the OMOP cells are affected (report separates them). A fixed-prompt version would need its own development check.
